embeds.title: ⚔️  Guild Board 1.3 has landed
embeds.description:
**Lok'tar ogar, Push To Prod.** The addon finally pulls its weight. Hover any item and it tells you who in the guild wants it, ping the crew for dungeons from your minimap, and see every ding and death as it happens.

**[⬇️  Download 1.3 now](https://github.com/KrisHendo09/guild-board/releases/latest)**  then restart WoW
